findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed the bathroom to the right of the water fountain did not have paper towels. The PIC provided paper towels to the bathroom during the inspection. Ensure there is always paper towels available at every hand washing sink.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed in the back receiving room to the right of the exit door there was a large crack in the wall. The PIC filled the crack with caulk during the inspection. Ensure the crack remains sealed to be a smooth, easily cleanable surface and prevent the entry of pests.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment: Observed several roaches at the facility. There were two glue traps with many dead roaches on them. There were also large dead roaches observed throughout the back of the facility and a couple in the main store. Additionally, one alive roach was seen on the water fountain and one in the back storage. There was also a large amount of drain flies throughout the entire facility. Upon entering the store and being asked about roaches the PIC stated that they are aware and EcoLab had performed pest control recently. The PIC was instructed to contact EcoLab and get immediate service. They should also put down more glue traps to figure out the location of the roaches, eliminate entrance points, and remove cardboard quickly. There will be a follow-up in two weeks to ensure EcoLab has been to the facility and pests are being eliminated.
